def get_max_sum(n: int) -> int:
    # res[i] holds f(i); fill bottom-up so every f(n // k) is ready when needed.
    res = [0] * (n + 2)
    if n >= 1:
        res[1] = 1
    for i in range(2, n + 1):
        split_sum = res[i // 2] + res[i // 3] + res[i // 4] + res[i // 5]
        res[i] = max(split_sum, i)
    return res[n]
